Put a random Attack from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
If your next Attack deals a [gold]Critical Hit[/gold], gain {Bonus:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
Otherwise, gain {Malus:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold], {Malus:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and {Malus:diff()} [gold]Debilitate[/gold], and end your turn.
[gold]Critical Draw:[/gold] {CriticalDraw:diff()}%
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_STRIKE.title: Strike
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_DEFEND.title: Defend
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RUNNING_JOKE.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add {DiscardCard:diff()} {DiscardCard:plural:copy|copies} of this card into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] and {DrawCard:diff()} {DrawCard:plural:copy|copies} into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RUNNING_JOKE.title: Running Joke
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_WALL_OF_TEXT.title: Wall Of Text
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SEE_WHAT_STICKS.des:
Add [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Fresh Idea+|Fresh Idea}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
Shuffle this card into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].|}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_STRIKES.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.{IfUpgraded:show:
Shuffle this card into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].|}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_STRIKES.title: Slime Strikes
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_RAIN.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Whenever you create a [gold]Slimed[/gold], increase this card's damage by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_RAIN.title: Slime Rain
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BELL_MEMORY.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Play a random Attack from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BELL_MEMORY.title: Bell Memory
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PUNCHING_BALL.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If the enemy intends to attack, apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PUNCHING_BALL.title: Punching Ball
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_IT_OFF.descri:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
The next {FreeStatus:diff()} Status {FreeStatus:plural:card|cards} you play {FreeStatus:plural:costs|cost} 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_IT_OFF.title: Slime It Off
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_QUICK_MEAL.descript:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Heal {Heal:diff()} HP for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this way.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_QUICK_MEAL.title: Quick Meal
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_DRAFT_PHASE.descrip:
Add [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Fresh Idea+|Fresh Idea}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Next turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_DRAFT_PHASE.title: Draft Phase
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_GORILLA_FORM.descri:
Lose {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
At the start of your turn, gain [gold]Vigor[/gold] equal to {RandomMult:cond:>1?{RandomMult:diff()} times |}your [gold]Random[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_GORILLA_FORM.title: Gorilla Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_DISTRACTION.descrip:
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
Gain [gold]Dexterity[/gold] equal to the enemy's [gold]Weak[/gold] this turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_DISTRACTION.title: Distraction
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RESHAPE.description:
Remove all your [gold]Frail[/gold].
[gold]Transform[/gold] ALL cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]Slimed[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RESHAPE.title: Reshape
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BURLESQUE_WIND_UP.d:
Gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
Until you play an Attack, whenever you play a card, gain {BurlesqueWindUp:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_FALSE_CON_PUNCH.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {Confusion:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold] to a random enemy for each card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].{InCombat:
(Hits {Hits:diff()} {Hits:plural:time|times})|}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_FAVOURITE_BUCKET.de: Gain [gold]Plating[/gold] equal to the number of Status and Curse cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_TURN_THE_TABLES.des:
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
Gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold] for each [gold]Weak[/gold] on the enemy.
If you are [gold]Weak[/gold], do this twice.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CREATIVE_SPIRIT.des:
At the start of your turn, add a [gold]Fresh Idea[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
[gold]Fresh Ideas[/gold] can also [gold]Transform[/gold] cards into [gold]Rare[/gold] cards.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_FRESH_IDEA.descript:
Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Random[/gold].
{IfUpgraded:show:Choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] to [gold]Transform[/gold]|[gold]Transform[/gold] a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]} into a random {InCombatHasCreativeSpirit:cond:>0?|non-[gold]Rare[/gold] }card.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_FRESH_IDEA.title: Fresh Idea
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_HUG.descripti:
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
If you are [gold]Weak[/gold], {IfUpgraded:show:triple|double} the enemy's [gold]Weak[/gold].
Apply [gold]Confusion[/gold] equal to the enemy's [gold]Weak[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_HUG.title: Slime Hug
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SURPRISE_SHAPESHIFT:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {Confusion:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold].
Add a random{IfUpgraded:show: upgraded|} Power ([gold]Bumper Form[/gold], [gold]Ventilator Form[/gold] or [gold]Squeaky Squirrel Form[/gold]) into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_LAUGHABLE_PUNCHES.d:
Gain {SelfWeak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
If the enemy lost no HP, apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_WAIT_A_SECOND.title: Wait a Second
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_WAIT_A_SECOND.descr:
Put {Cards:diff()} random colored {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Put {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Hand[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_WAIT_A_SECOND.selec: Choose cards to put on top of your Draw Pile.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PROOF_READING.title: Proof Reading
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PROOF_READING.descr:
Put a random colored card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.|} It is free to play this turn.
Add [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Maybe Later+|Maybe Later}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_OLD_IDEAS.title: Old Ideas
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_OLD_IDEAS.descripti: Put {Cards:diff()} colored [gold]Novel[/gold] {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. {Cards:plural:It costs|They cost} {Energy:energyIcons()} less this combat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_OLD_IDEAS.selection: Choose Novel cards to put into your Hand.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_LOGIC_SHIFT.title: Logic Shift
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_MAYBE_LATER.title: Maybe Later
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_MAYBE_LATER.descrip: Shuffle a card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_MAYBE_LATER.selecti: Choose a card to shuffle into your Draw Pile.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CREATIVE_BREAK.desc:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Add [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Fresh Idea+|Fresh Idea}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Maybe Later+|Maybe Later}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PLOT_TWIST.title: Plot Twist
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PLOT_TWIST.descript:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:a card|a random card} in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Add a random{IfUpgraded:show: upgraded|} card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CHAOTIC_CLONE.title: Chaotic Clone
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CHAOTIC_CLONE.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
{IfUpgraded:show:Play ALL [gold]Slimed[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] for each card played this way.|Play a random [gold]Slimed[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. If you do, gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_HARMLESS_LOOK.title: Harmless Look
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_HARMLESS_LOOK.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you are [gold]Weak[/gold], gain it again.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_FRONTFLIP_AND_A_HAL:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies and yourself.
If you lost HP this turn, apply {Confusion:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_HAMMER.title: Slime Hammer
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_HAMMER.descri:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Slimy[/gold] card you have.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PUZZLING_TIP.title: Puzzling Tip
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PUZZLING_TIP.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {Confusion:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold].
Add a random{IfUpgraded:show: upgraded|} Colorless card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SHARE_SECRETS.title: Share Secrets
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SHARE_SECRETS.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {Confusion:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold].
Add [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Fresh Idea+|Fresh Idea}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SHRIEKING_LAUGH.des:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Weak[/gold] on the enemy.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BACK_SLAP.title: Back Slap
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BACK_SLAP.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Until your next turn, take [blue]50%[/blue] less Attack damage from [gold]Weak[/gold] enemies.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PINBALL_MOVE.title: Pinball Move
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PINBALL_MOVE.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy and apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to it {Repeat:diff()} times.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_DICE_SHOTGUN.title: Dice Shotgun
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BURST_OF_LAUGHTER.d:
Gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
This turn, double the [gold]Confusion[/gold] you apply to enemies with less [gold]Confusion[/gold] than the number of cards in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BOLD_ANNOUNCEMENT.d:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
For each enemy, gain {ThornsPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold] if it lost no HP. Otherwise, add a random Power into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CARTOONISH_MIMICKER:
Discard your [gold]Hand[/gold].
For each Status or Curse discarded this way, put a random colored card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CARTOONY_DODGE.desc:
Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Random[/gold] for each unique {IfUpgraded:show:buff or debuff|buff} you have, then gain that much [gold]Block[/gold].{InCombat:
(Gain {RandomGain:diff()} [gold]Random[/gold])|}
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_ANCHOR_THROW.title: Anchor Throw
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_ANCHOR_THROW.descri: Whenever you play a card that puts a card into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], this enemy gains {AnchoredDown:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_EMERGENCY_SHAPESHIF: [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] random cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into{IfUpgraded:show: upgraded|} [gold]Sword Form[/gold], [gold]Octopus Form[/gold] and [gold]Box of Nails Form[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_TRUE_SIZE.title: True Size
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_TRUE_SIZE.descripti: Add {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} [gold]Slimed[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They are free to play this turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_INTRODUCTION.title: Introduction
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_INTRODUCTION.descri:
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Gain {SelfWeak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Add [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Description+|Description}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_DESCRIPTION.title: Description
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_DESCRIPTION.descrip:
Apply [gold]Weak[/gold] equal to your [gold]Random[/gold], then gain as much [gold]Weak[/gold].
Add [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Conclusion+|Conclusion}[/gold] and{IfUpgraded:show: upgraded|} [gold]Bumper Form[/gold], [gold]Ventilator Form[/gold] and [gold]Squeaky Squirrel Form[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CONCLUSION.title: Conclusion
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CONCLUSION.descript: At the end of your turn, apply [gold]Confusion[/gold] to ALL enemies equal to the number of times you gained [gold]Random[/gold] this combat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_TUBE_MAN_FORM.title: Tube Man Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_TUBE_MAN_FORM.descr: Whenever you gain, lose or apply [gold]Weak[/gold], deal {TubeManForm:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_FORM.title: Slime Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_FORM.descript: Whenever you play a [gold]Slimy[/gold] card, apply {SlimeForm:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to a random enemy and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SARCOPHAGUS_FORM.de:
Whenever you apply [gold]Weak[/gold] to an enemy, gain {SarcophagusForm:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you gain [gold]Weak[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_STREET_LIGHT_FORM.d: Whenever you play a [gold]Fresh Idea[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons(1)}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_HAT_TIP.title: Hat Tip
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_HAT_TIP.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Slimy[/gold] card, add {HatTip:diff()} [gold]Slimed[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_DANGEROUS_IDEAS.des: Whenever you gain [gold]Random[/gold], apply {DangerousIdeas:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold] to a random enemy.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIME_APPETITE.desc:
Whenever you create a [gold]Slimed[/gold], gain {SlimeAppetite:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you play a [gold]Slimed[/gold], gain {Dexterity:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
The first {AppleJuiceStocks:plural:[gold]Slimed[/gold]|[blue]{}[/blue] [gold]Slimed[/gold]} you play from your [gold]Hand[/gold] each turn {AppleJuiceStocks:plural:is|are} played an additional time and {AppleJuiceStocks:plural:grants|grant} {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_VOLATILE_FORM.title: Volatile Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_VOLATILE_FORM.descr: Whenever a Status or Curse is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], deal {VolatileForm:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
Whenever you hit an enemy, if it doesn't lose more HP than your [gold]Weak[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIDE_FORM.title: Slide Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SLIDE_FORM.descript: Whenever you create a card, apply {SlideForm:diff()} [gold]Confusion[/gold] to a random enemy.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_NEXT_TOPIC.title: Next Topic
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CAMOUFLAGED_TRAP.de:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Slimed[/gold] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CRYPTED_LORE.title: Crypted Lore
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CRYPTED_LORE.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Double the enemy's [gold]Confusion[/gold].
If it has {StunThreshold:diff()} or more [gold]Confusion[/gold], [gold]Stun[/gold] it.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_REACTIVE_SHAPE.desc:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you play a [gold]Form[/gold] Power, put this card into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and increase its [gold]Block[/gold] by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BLOOPER.title: Blooper
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BLOOPER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Increase the [gold]Block[/gold] of ALL [gold]Blooper[/gold] cards by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
Add a copy of this card into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CONTINUITY_THREAD.d: Next turn, put {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CHANGE_OF_PLAN.desc:
Discard your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Add a random{IfUpgraded:show: upgraded|} card into your [gold]Hand[/gold] for each card discarded.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_MOOD_SHIFT.title: Mood Shift
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_MOOD_SHIFT.descript: Put a Power from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_MOOD_SHIFT.selectio: Choose a Power to put into your Hand.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_TABULA_RASA.title: Tabula Rasa
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_TABULA_RASA.descrip:
Add [gold]Novel[/gold] to ALL your cards.
Your [gold]Random[/gold] drops to [blue]1[/blue].
{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Upgrade[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold].
|}ALL cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] are free to play this turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_REVERSE_BEAM.title: Reverse Beam
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_REVERSE_BEAM.descri:
Add [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Incoming Beam+|Incoming Beam}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Add a copy of each card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_INCOMING_BEAM.title: Incoming Beam
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_INCOMING_BEAM.descr:
Lose all [gold]Weak[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Whenever you create a card, increase this card's damage by {Increase:diff()}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_ABSORPTION.title: Absorption
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_ABSORPTION.descript:
Gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
Deal damage equal to the enemy's [gold]Weak[/gold].{InCombat:
(Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], raise your Max HP by {MaxHp:diff()}.
Add a random{IfUpgraded:show: upgraded|} [gold]Form[/gold] Power ([gold]Pony Form[/gold], [gold]Television Form[/gold] or [gold]Sparrow Form[/gold]) into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_FRIDGE_FORM.title: Fridge Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_FRIDGE_FORM.descrip:
Gain a potion slot and procure a random potion.
Whenever you play a [gold]Form[/gold] Power, procure {FridgeForm:diff()} random {FridgeForm:plural:potion|potions}.
At the end of combat, discard ALL your potions and lose {FridgeForm:diff()} potion {FridgeForm:plural:slot|slots}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_GENIE_FORM.title: Genie Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_GENIE_FORM.descript:
Every [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Random[/gold] you gain, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to a random enemy.
Cards you create can be of any color.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_FOX_FORM.title: Fox Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_FOX_FORM.descriptio:
{WeakPower:cond:>0?Gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
|}At the end of your turn, if you have no [gold]Weak[/gold], gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold].
Otherwise, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn and {Strength:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_TOUCAN_FORM.title: Toucan Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_TOUCAN_FORM.descrip:
Gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
At the start of your turn, if you are [gold]Weak[/gold], gain {ToucanForm:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CACTUS_FORM.title: Cactus Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CACTUS_FORM.descrip:
Gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
At the start of your turn, if you have [blue]8[/blue] or more [gold]Weak[/gold], lose [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] and gain {CactusForm:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_ANGLERFISH_FORM.des:
Gain {SlipperyPower:diff()} [gold]Slippery[/gold].
Whenever you apply [gold]Weak[/gold] to an enemy, also apply {AnglerfishForm:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to it.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PINWHEEL_FORM.title: Pinwheel Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_PINWHEEL_FORM.descr: Whenever you apply [gold]Confusion[/gold], it also targets ALL other enemies and applies {PinwheelForm:diff()} additional [gold]Confusion[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_WALKING_ENCYCLOPEDI: Add a copy of the first card you play each turn on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. The copy costs {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} more.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BUMPER_FORM.title: Bumper Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_BUMPER_FORM.descrip: Whenever you play a Power, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} next turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_VENTILATOR_FORM.des: Whenever you play a Power, ALL enemies lose {VentilatorForm:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SQUEAKY_SQUIRREL_FO: Whenever you play a Power, put {SqueakySquirrelForm:diff()} random colored {SqueakySquirrelForm:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SWORD_FORM.title: Sword Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SWORD_FORM.descript: The first {SwordForm:diff()} {SwordForm:plural:Attack|Attacks} you play each turn {SwordForm:plural:grants|grant} [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_OCTOPUS_FORM.title: Octopus Form
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_OCTOPUS_FORM.descri:
Gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
The first {OctopusForm:diff()} {OctopusForm:plural:time|times} you target an enemy each turn, it loses [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
